boundaries: A: packaged App, original native content stream and completion held unchanged; first original match delivered before real dialog close, then actual task/root navigation, then new real search, then remaining old original notifications/completion. Modal requires close before sidebar/root actions; direct task/root lifecycle is additionally verified in I. Isolated Python PTYs only, no model, commands, clipboard, Store or editor injection.

A uses actual packaged App tree/tab/menu pointer input and reads actual CodeMirror document only. Ordinary writer uses fs, CLI writer is separate python3, neither uses task input. PTYs are genuine input-only Python foreground processes: busy means sustained genuine output, not model computation. No-current-terminal is project file workspace; no handoff records are created. For reactivate/refresh, delay only original own files:watch delivery to prove direct reads without notifications, then deliver unchanged originals. Stale success/open/error gates delay originals unchanged; actual chmod000 causes PERMISSION, physical replacement creates new inode. No model, clipboard, Store/editor injection, custom App success/error packets or daily paths.

R11 A requires closing real modal before task/root click; direct scope lifecycle + real abort is I. Streaming original native operation already completed when success held, not a claim active OS read remains running. I start-pending boundary verifies cancellation of live native request signal.

Busy state is genuine own foreground PTY output, no model work. No-current-terminal is project view with authorized files and no task handoff. Stopped task confirms native ptyId null and actual exit output; browsed without resume.

Sixteen original watch notifications withheld only during reactivate/refresh; original channel, payload hashes and restoration verified. Two late-read cases physically replace inode, close and explicitly reopen before delivering original success or actual chmod000 PERMISSION.
Original r57 build six native smokes reused; current runtime81 hashes reverified, all production inputs unchanged, final1046-source tar/hash recoverable. No test-only mutation packaged.

No prototype UI change; only existing authorized flows tested, P/V/reference/physicalIME and all other unexecuted cases remain separate. Failures/partial results retained, no source replacement or daily AIS usage.
